title: Systems & Product Engineering
subtitle: About
description: I am a Systems Product Engineer and Technical Founder focused on building intelligent products and technology systems by combining embedded hardware, IoT, AI-assisted software, and applied research. My work spans wearable health technology, engineering collaboration platforms, embedded systems, product prototyping, and innovation-driven system design. I focus on transforming ideas into complete engineering systems by taking them from concept and architecture through development, testing, documentation, validation, and product realization.
